basic_details.short_information: The University Grants Commission (UGC), under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, New Delhi, has invited online applications for the post of Secretary, UGC, on deputation or contract basis. The pay is Level-15, Rs. 1,82,200-2,24,100 in the Pay Matrix, plus admissible allowances. The tenure is 5 years, renewable for one more term of 5 years. Applications are open on the UGC website www.ugc.gov.in/Tenders/jobs until 15 January 2027.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is 58 years, as per the DoPT OM. The notice prints no age relaxation. Eligibility is determined as on the last date of submission of the application form.

selection_process: shortlists candidates from all the applications received. Its decision is binding on all. Candidates shortlisted for interview are informed by website notification/email. Applications with higher qualifications or merit may be given preference. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.
how_to_apply: Fill the application form online at www.ugc.gov.in/Tenders/jobs and go through the application process given on that website. The notice asks candidates to follow the instructions given there from time to time.
Keep a valid e-mail ID and mobile number. Information about the call letter, interview and acknowledgement is sent by email and SMS.
Scan the photograph in JPEG format, with a file size of less than 200 KB.
Scan and upload the CVO certificate that no vigilance/disciplinary enquiry is pending or contemplated against you.
Upload the No Objection Certificate from the forwarding authority (present employer) with APARs for the last five years, attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary/equivalent.
After successful submission, note the reference number shown on screen. It can be used to reopen the data for viewing and printing.
Submit the form by 15 January 2027. The notice states that no hard copy will be accepted.

content_sections.heading: About UGC
content_sections.text: The University Grants Commission functions under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Its office is at Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi - 110002. This notice is for the post of Secretary, UGC, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is filled by transfer on deputation or on contract. A candidate must fall in one of these three groups: A person who has served or is serving as a Professor/Scholar in a University or any Institution of Higher Education/Research, with at least 10 years' experience of teaching at post-graduate level or guiding research, and experience of educational administration. Officers of Central/State Governments or Public enterprises not below the rank of Joint Secretary to the Government of India. Officers of Universities, research institutes and academic organizations not below the rank of Registrar or equivalent, with at least 10 years' experience in that capacity. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is 58 years, as per the DoPT OM. The notice prints no age relaxation. Eligibility is determined as on the last date of submission of the application form. Candidates who have not completed the prescribed "cooling off" period as per DoP&T regulations are not entitled to apply for the deputation post. A person in a higher grade pay shall not be eligible for appointment to a post carrying a lower grade pay. The prescribed qualifications are minimum. Possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. The educational qualification is not printed separately in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay is Level-15, Rs. 1,82,200-2,24,100 in the Pay Matrix (pre-revised 67000-79000), plus allowances admissible to UGC employees on deputation or contract basis. Appointment on deputation is subject to the Government of India DoPT OM No. 06/08/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. Tenure: 5 years, renewable for one more term of 5 years, both subject to the age of retirement applicable in the organisation from which the person comes on deputation or contract. Pay option: during foreign service the officer has an option, to be exercised within one month of joining, regarding pay and allowance, including protection of pay as per the DoPT OM. Termination of contract: either party may end a contract appointment by giving three months' notice in advance. Transfer: UGC service carries All India transfer liability. TA/DA: paid by UGC as admissible under UGC rules, including the journey to join the post and the return to the parent organisation. Joining time: regulated by Central Government Rules. UGC pays the joining time pay. Leave: governed by the Government of India leave rules. UGC pays the leave salary contribution to the parent organisation. Pension: the officer will not be enrolled in any pension/contributory provident fund/NPS scheme of UGC. UGC pays pension contributions to the parent organisation at the rates in force. Provident fund: the officer continues to subscribe to the GPF/CPF/NPS of the parent organisation. Medical: CGHS facility if posted in New Delhi. Other benefits: LTC as admissible, Government residential accommodation from the general pool of the Directorate of Estates, New Delhi, and children's education allowance or tuition fee reimbursement as admissible to a Central Government officer. Insurance: the officer is governed by the Group Insurance Scheme of the parent organisation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UGC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application form online at www.ugc.gov.in/Tenders/jobs and go through the application process given on that website. The notice asks candidates to follow the instructions given there from time to time. Keep a valid e-mail ID and mobile number. Information about the call letter, interview and acknowledgement is sent by email and SMS. Scan the photograph in JPEG format, with a file size of less than 200 KB. Scan and upload the CVO certificate that no vigilance/disciplinary enquiry is pending or contemplated against you. Upload the No Objection Certificate from the forwarding authority (present employer) with APARs for the last five years, attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary/equivalent. After successful submission, note the reference number shown on screen. It can be used to reopen the data for viewing and printing. Submit the form by 15 January 2027. The notice states that no hard copy will be accepted. The notice gives the UGC contact numbers 011-23604240 and 011-23604201 on its letterhead.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee, constituted for the purpose, shortlists candidates from all the applications received. Its decision is binding on all. Candidates shortlisted for interview are informed by website notification/email. Applications with higher qualifications or merit may be given preference. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the UGC Secretary post?
faq.answer: The last date for filling up the online form is 15 January 2027. The notice does not print a closing time.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for the post of Secretary, UGC?
faq.answer: A Professor/Scholar with at least 10 years' experience of teaching at post-graduate level or guiding research and experience of educational administration can apply. So can an officer not below Joint Secretary to the Government of India, or an officer not below Registrar or equivalent with at least 10 years' experience in that capacity.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the UGC Secretary post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is 58 years, as per the DoPT OM. Eligibility is determined as on the last date of submission of the application form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the UGC Secretary?
faq.answer: The pay is Level-15, Rs. 1,82,200-2,24,100 in the Pay Matrix, plus admissible allowances as admissible to UGC employees on deputation or contract basis.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for UGC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at www.ugc.gov.in/Tenders/jobs. Upload the documents listed in the notice, including the NOC and APARs for the last five years. No hard copy will be accepted.

faq.question: Q6. How are candidates selected for the UGC Secretary post?
faq.answer: A Screening Committee shortlists candidates from the applications received. Shortlisted candidates are called for interview and informed by website notification or email.

faq.question: Q7. Is the UGC Secretary post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the post is filled on deputation or contract basis. The tenure is 5 years, renewable for one more term of 5 years, subject to the age of retirement applicable to the parent organisation.

faq.question: Q8. Is a No Objection Certificate required to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, applications are entertained only if the No Objection Certificate from the present employer is uploaded. APARs for the last five years, attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary/equivalent, must be uploaded with it.

faq.question: Q9. Can a contract appointee be removed during the term?
faq.answer: Either party can end a contract appointment by giving three months' notice in advance. Violation of contract terms or misconduct is dealt with as per the contractual terms.
